# Conclusions

The Data Section's activities in 2026 combined the routine processing, validation and dissemination of fisheries datasets with targeted technical assistance to CPCs, capacity-building workshops and continued development of reporting tools and information systems. These activities supported the implementation of IOTC reporting requirements, the preparation of datasets for scientific assessments and technical meetings, and improvements in data quality and management procedures.

Further work will focus on strengthening national data collection and reporting capacities, developing standardised validation and processing workflows, modernising information systems and addressing outstanding data-related requests from IOTC scientific and technical bodies. The activities supported through EC1350 and SWIOP will contribute to these priorities in the coming years.
